sealMiracleDesc: Awarded when the PR rating reaches 2100 over at least 500 battles.
sealApeDesc: Awarded when the PR rating is below 750 and the winrate is 40% or higher (or unknown).
sealMaggotDesc: Awarded when the PR rating is below 750 and the winrate is under 40%.
sealRatDesc: Awarded when the stats are hidden and the player's clan winrate is 53% or lower — or when they are in no clan.
sealAirDesc: Awarded when carrier battles exceed 20% of a career totalling more than 200 battles.
sealSubDesc: Awarded when submarine battles exceed 20% of a career totalling more than 200 battles.
